metrics.label: E-commerce order quantity (operational)
metrics.decision_purpose: Monitor source-recorded marketplace demand before posting reconciliation
metrics.grain: day x platform x city x sellable SKU
metrics.additivity: additive across declared dimensions
metrics.reconciliation: reconcile to SAP invoice quantity when SAP becomes ready
metrics.display_qualifier: Operational source events; not posted sales

metrics.label: E-commerce sale value (operational)
metrics.grain: day x platform x city x sellable SKU x currency
metrics.additivity: additive only within one currency
metrics.reconciliation: reconcile by document and currency to posted SAP revenue
metrics.display_qualifier: Operational value in stated currency; not posted revenue

metrics.label: Observed listing availability rate
metrics.grain: observation window x platform x listing x observation location
metrics.time_basis: observation timestamp and bounded crawl window
metrics.additivity: non-additive ratio
metrics.reconciliation: report numerator, denominator, and crawl coverage
metrics.display_qualifier: Bounded observations only; not universal platform availability

metrics.label: Observed competitor shelf price
metrics.grain: observation timestamp x platform x listing x observation location x currency
metrics.formula: latest valid observed shelf price at the declared grain
metrics.additivity: non-additive observation
metrics.reconciliation: retain every observation and report crawl coverage
metrics.display_qualifier: Observed price at a bounded time/location; not universal

metrics.label: Observed JIVO-to-competitor price index
metrics.grain: observation date x platform x matched sellable SKU x currency
metrics.formula: observed JIVO price / observed matched competitor price
metrics.additivity: non-additive ratio
metrics.reconciliation: require identity match and same currency, pack, platform, and observation window
metrics.display_qualifier: Proxy from matched bounded observations; not a universal market index

metrics.label: Factory scanned dispatch quantity
metrics.grain: dispatch event x factory location x item x UOM
metrics.additivity: additive after UOM conformance
metrics.reconciliation: reconcile scans to SAP posted inventory movements when ready
metrics.display_qualifier: Physical operational scans; not SAP-posted movement

metrics.label: Factory QC pass rate
metrics.grain: day x factory location x item x QC test
metrics.formula: passed QC events / completed QC events
metrics.additivity: non-additive ratio
metrics.reconciliation: report pass and completed counts; exclude incomplete explicitly
metrics.display_qualifier: Recorded QC events at declared grain

metrics.label: Factory barcode event count
metrics.grain: day x factory location x barcode event type x item
metrics.additivity: additive across non-overlapping event sets
metrics.reconciliation: deduplicate by stable event ID and compare expected process steps
metrics.display_qualifier: Operational barcode observations; not stock quantity

metrics.label: Factory-recorded GRPO quantity
metrics.decision_purpose: Monitor factory receipt workflow before posting
metrics.grain: factory GRPO event x item x location x UOM
metrics.additivity: additive after UOM conformance
metrics.reconciliation: reconcile to SAP posted GRPO by document and line when ready
metrics.display_qualifier: Factory workflow event; not SAP-posted GRPO

metrics.label: Distributor expected stock
metrics.decision_purpose: Plan replenishment using expected book movement
metrics.grain: sheet snapshot x distributor x location x item x UOM
metrics.additivity: additive after identity and UOM conformance
metrics.reconciliation: compare with dated physical count; preserve residual
metrics.display_qualifier: Expected/book proxy; not physical stock

metrics.label: Distributor physical stock observation
metrics.grain: count date x distributor x count location x item x UOM
metrics.additivity: additive for non-overlapping count locations after UOM conformance
metrics.reconciliation: compare only to expected stock at aligned cutoff
metrics.display_qualifier: Dated physical observation; not current outside count cutoff

metrics.label: Distributor physical-to-expected stock variance
metrics.grain: aligned cutoff x distributor x location x item x UOM
metrics.time_basis: aligned physical count and expected-stock cutoff
metrics.additivity: additive only after cutoff, identity, and UOM alignment
metrics.reconciliation: retain both inputs and unexplained residual
metrics.display_qualifier: Reconciliation proxy combining physical observation and expected book stock

metrics.label: Distributor open claim amount
metrics.grain: workbook snapshot x claim x distributor x currency
metrics.formula: sum(claim amount where workbook status is open)
metrics.additivity: additive only within one currency and distinct claims
metrics.reconciliation: reconcile to posted credit notes and GL when SAP is ready
metrics.display_qualifier: Operational claim register; not posted financial liability

metrics.label: SAP posted revenue
metrics.grain: posted invoice line x legal entity x item x currency
metrics.formula: sum(posted invoice line net amount with cancellations/reversals)
metrics.additivity: additive within currency; reporting currency uses governed FX basis
metrics.reconciliation: tie document totals to GL revenue and preserve reversals
metrics.display_qualifier: Draft until SAP source is ready; intended posted actual

metrics.label: SAP posted invoice quantity
metrics.grain: posted invoice line x legal entity x item x UOM
metrics.additivity: additive after UOM conformance
metrics.reconciliation: tie line quantity to document and operational order quantity
metrics.display_qualifier: Draft until SAP source is ready; posted billing quantity

metrics.label: SAP book inventory quantity
metrics.grain: as-of time x legal entity x warehouse x item x UOM
metrics.time_basis: SAP posting timestamp through as-of cutoff
metrics.additivity: semi-additive; additive across items/warehouses, not time
metrics.reconciliation: tie movements to SAP balance and physical counts separately
metrics.display_qualifier: Draft until SAP source is ready; book quantity, not physical count

metrics.label: SAP posted inventory value
metrics.grain: as-of time x legal entity x warehouse x item x currency
metrics.formula: sum(posted inventory value movements through cutoff)
metrics.time_basis: SAP posting timestamp through as-of cutoff
metrics.additivity: semi-additive within currency; not additive across time
metrics.reconciliation: tie to inventory GL control accounts by legal entity/currency
metrics.display_qualifier: Draft until SAP source is ready; posted accounting value

metrics.label: SAP posted receivable balance
metrics.grain: as-of date x legal entity x customer x currency
metrics.formula: sum(posted open receivable debit and credit items)
metrics.time_basis: posting and due dates through as-of cutoff
metrics.additivity: semi-additive within currency; not across time
metrics.reconciliation: tie subledger to GL control account
metrics.display_qualifier: Draft until SAP source is ready; posted open balance

metrics.label: SAP posted payable balance
metrics.grain: as-of date x legal entity x vendor x currency
metrics.formula: sum(posted open payable debit and credit items)
metrics.time_basis: posting and due dates through as-of cutoff
metrics.additivity: semi-additive within currency; not across time
metrics.reconciliation: tie subledger to GL control account
metrics.display_qualifier: Draft until SAP source is ready; posted open balance

metrics.label: SAP general-ledger balance
metrics.grain: posting period x legal entity x GL account x currency
metrics.formula: opening posted balance + posted debits - posted credits
metrics.additivity: semi-additive within currency and chart hierarchy; not across time
metrics.reconciliation: tie journal lines to trial balance and closed-period controls
metrics.display_qualifier: Draft until SAP source is ready; posted ledger balance
